at 2026-07-15T12:00:00Z
exec card init --prefix archive- --board-name 'Archive board'
exec card board use 'Archive board'
exec sh -c 'printf "version: 1\nissue:\n  id:\n    prefix: archive-\n    strategy: sequential\n" > .cardamom/config.yaml'

# Open issues are archived as-is and reported by effective status.
exec card create 'Ready issue'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/ready-id.txt
exec card create 'Prerequisite'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/prerequisite-id.txt
exec card create --depends-on archive-2 'Blocked issue'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/blocked-id.txt
exec card create 'Waiting issue'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/waiting-id.txt
exec card claim archive-4
exec card release archive-4 --waiting 'awaiting continuation'

# Active custody is the only issue-state barrier to archival.
exec card claim archive-1
! exec card board archive 'Archive board' --reason 'Retired coordination context'
! stdout .
stderr 'board has an active claim'
exec card release archive-1
exec sh -c 'printf retained > retained.txt'

exec card --json board archive 'Archive board' --reason 'Retired coordination context'
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/archived.json

# Ordinary discovery omits the archived board while explicit reads retain it.
exec card --json board list
! stdout .
exec card --json board list --include-archived
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/archived-list.jsonl
exec card --json board show
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/archived-board.json

# Checkout selection continues to resolve reads and rejects mutations.
! exec card create 'Rejected issue'
! stdout .
stderr 'board is archived'
! exec card board edit --name 'Rejected rename'
! stdout .
stderr 'board is archived'
! exec card config set --scope board issue.id.strategy random
! stdout .
stderr 'board is archived'
! exec card attachment add retained.txt
! stdout .
stderr 'board is archived'

# Repeating either lifecycle operation is a successful no-op.
exec card --json board archive 'Archive board' --reason 'Replacement reason'
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/already-archived.json
exec card --json board unarchive 'Archive board'
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/unarchived.json
exec card --json board unarchive 'Archive board'
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/already-active.json
exec card --json board list
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/active-list.jsonl
